pending.title: To decide
pending.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
pending.chooseCategory: What kind of document is this?
pending.noOptions: Nothing to choose from — please add entries under Settings.

apps.title: Apps
apps.author: Provider
apps.settingsIntro: Answer this solution's questions. You can change them at any time.

models.title: Models
models.intro: Which models this instance may call, where they compute and what they cost. Clearance = highest data class; the dominance rule and the legal space are checked before every call. Releasing (status “released”) is a human decision.
models.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen — e.g. haiku, llama-local
models.modelHelp: Name at the provider, e.g. claude-haiku-4-5, llama3.1:8b, mistral-large-latest
models.baseUrlHelp: Empty = the provider's default. For EU providers the OpenAI-compatible URL, e.g. https://api.mistral.ai/v1
models.statusHelp: Only released models are ever called.
models.regionHelp: Where the provider computes (its own statement).
models.dpaHelp: A data processing agreement with the provider exists.
models.testNotPulled: Model not pulled in Ollama — available: {available}
models.legalNoCountry: No country known — only the dominance rule applies. Set the country under
models.legalUnknown: No rule is defined for {country}; only the dominance rule applies.
models.legalRule: From data class “{from}” on, data only goes to local models or to providers in the regions {regions} with a DPA.
models.legalNote: A product rule, not legal advice: the operator remains responsible for providers and agreements; the rule makes the consequence visible and mechanical.
models.keysIntro: Stored only, never shown (file readable by the owner only). A key from the environment wins and cannot be changed here.
models.newSecretHelp: Name as in the tool: {secret:name}; lowercase, digits, _
models.keyInFormMissing: No key stored yet – enter it here, it applies to every entry of this provider.
models.keyInFormPresent: Key present ({from}) – fill in only to replace it.

mandates.title: Rules
mandates.intro: Standing rules deliver without asking. Every rule can be revoked at any time.
mandates.suggest: {count}× delivered by hand to {target} — create a rule?
mandates.suggestGate: {count}× decided the same way in “{process}” ({target}) — do it without asking from now on?

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.intro: Outside tools via the Model Context Protocol: where a server runs, which key opens it and which of its tools may be called. Solutions only know the name. Every call waits for an approval, the answer is foreign content.
mcp.name: Name
mcp.nameHelp: The name the solutions' tools use, e.g. github
mcp.noServers: No servers yet. A server brings its tools; only what is allowed here can be called.
mcp.zapierHelp: Zapier MCP: create a server on mcp.zapier.com, add the actions you want and copy the token under “Connect” – enter it here as the key. Then “Fetch tools”. Every successful call costs 2 Zapier tasks, and every call waits for an approval here.

setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: A household consists of one or more mandants — for example “Private” and “Company X” — and one shared inbox.
setup.name: Name
setup.launcherMissing: No launcher reachable — mandants are created through the launcher. This instance runs on its own.
setup.created: Mandant created. The launcher starts the instance.
setup.step2: Choose a model (API key or local)
setup.profilesIntro: Country, name and identifiers — the basis for templates and for the legal-space rules of model access.
setup.step2b: Fill in the profile (country, name, identifiers)

placeholder.chat: Chat as an input channel arrives with the channel concept.
placeholder.improvements: Requests: solve internally, find in the catalog or submit as a solution request — arrives with the platform.
placeholder.workshop: The workshop shows templates, agents and tools for contributors.
placeholder.users: Users and approvals arrive with the user concept.
placeholder.channels: Channels: folder, mailbox, form, chat — management follows.

auth.intro: Sign in with the user created during setup.
auth.noLauncher: No launcher reachable – sign-in goes through the household's launcher.
auth.name: User name
auth.failed: Sign-in failed: unknown user or wrong password.
auth.off: This household has no users – sign-in is off. “aitmation-launcher user add” turns it on.
auth.usersIntro: The people of the household. Admins see everything; members work in their assigned mandants. The shared inbox is visible to everyone.

chat.intro: Ask where things stand — the chat is an input path into this application's own views, not a chatbot. Decisions go through the same gate as everywhere else.
chat.helpText: I show what waits for a decision, which cases exist and the trail of a single case (give its number). With “Create a post about …” or “Start …” I open a process's start form. You can decide right here — the case is logged as always.

answer.noPending: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
answer.caseAmbiguous: The number {id} matches several cases — please give it in full.
answer.help: Here is what I can do:
answer.unknown: I did not understand that. Ask for pending decisions, for cases, or give a case number.
answer.startWhich: {count} processes can be started — which one?

document.truncated: Preview shortened — the whole document via “Open document”.
document.pending: The recording is transcribed at the next processing step — locally on this instance.

upload.title: Hand in a document
upload.subject: Subject
upload.textHint: Type a text, dictate, or pick a file
upload.done: {count} document(s) handed to {member} — shows up in To decide in a moment.

doctypes.title: Document types
doctypes.intro: What the intake should recognise. Types from an app bundle stay untouched — what you adapt lives in this instance's own bundle and can be reset any time.
doctypes.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen — never translated.
doctypes.name: Name
doctypes.featuresHelp: One per line — what the intake recognises the type by.
doctypes.chainHelp: The template a recognised document runs into.
doctypes.fieldsHelp: One line per field: identifier = description (what to read from it).
doctypes.saved: Document type saved — the intake uses it from now on.

workshop.intro: What happens to a document — every template as a picture drawn from its declaration. Look, don't build: boxes are steps, arrows are outcomes, dashed doors lead into the next template.

records.title: Master data
records.intro: Who this mandant is: company or household profile with country, identifiers and address. Templates see these details only when they explicitly ask for them; every change is kept as a version.
records.empty: No master data is declared for this mandant.

channels.title: Channels
channels.intro: How documents reach this mandant: folder, mailbox, web form, hand-in — and, on the inbox, the addressees it delivers to. Credentials are stored, never shown.
channels.folderHelp: Files placed here (scanner, drag and drop, sync) appear as pending items.
channels.uploadHelp: Always on: file, photo, text or dictation from the pending list and the chat, as the signed-in person.
channels.mailHelp: Unread messages are fetched; each attachment becomes a case. The password goes into the protected file.
channels.testIncomplete: The mailbox is not fully set up (server, user, password).
channels.webHelp: A form on the website sends documents with a token to {endpoint}. Without a token the channel is off.
channels.tokenRevoked: Token revoked; the channel is off.
channels.tokenOnce: This token is shown only now — copy it and put it into the form.
channels.addresseesHelp: Who the inbox delivers to: one delivery folder per addressee (usually a mandant's inbox folder). Standing rules are managed under
channels.addresseePathHelp: Absolute path, e.g. the mandant's inbox folder.
channels.catchAllHelp: Grants a standing mandate without condition — the single-mandant case. Revoke under Rules.
channels.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen — e.g. private, company-x
channels.notifyHelp: Who learns that a decision is waiting: immediately on a new pending item, a reminder after the waiting time, an escalation to the deputy after the escalation time or when a deadline passes. Templates may only shorten the times. Messages never carry document content.
channels.publicUrlHelp: Linked in messages; empty = this computer
channels.notifyIncomplete: SMTP server and sender are missing.
channels.subject: Subject

deadlines.title: Deadlines
deadlines.intro: What is coming: follow-ups and deadlines across all mandants, and the templates that run on the calendar. On the day it becomes a pending item — decided, as always, at the gate.
deadlines.created: Follow-up created — it will appear in the pending list on the day.
deadlines.schedulesHelp: Templates with a time trigger (daily, weekly, monthly). A missed slot runs once, not once per missed day.
deadlines.noSchedules: No template runs on the calendar.

overview.knowledge: What the instance knows: knowledge spaces, master data and the rules it decides by.
overview.spaces: Guidelines, instructions and templates agents rely on — with sources.
overview.records: Company profile, contacts, accounts — versioned, per client.
overview.rules: Standing mandates and rule suggestions from manual decisions.
overview.apps: Ready-made solutions: what is installed, what the catalog offers, what is missing.
overview.installed: Switch installed apps on and off, settings per app.
overview.improvements: Requests: solve internally, find in the catalog or submit a wish.
overview.workshop: Technical toolbox for contributors: templates, agents and tools.
overview.settings: Running the installation: state, figures, access, models, logs.
overview.system: State of every instance: version, model, mailbox, templates, open tasks.
overview.metrics: What the automation costs, whether approvals still fit, how much flows — and the model budget.
overview.users: Who may sign in and who administers.
overview.channels: How documents arrive (folder, mailbox, form) and who is notified.
overview.doctypes: Document types with features, fields and target chain.
overview.models: Model access: provider, clearance, region, legal space, keys.
overview.operations: What ran, what is running and what it waits on, what comes next, errors and token usage — on one page.

metrics.title: Key figures
metrics.intro: Aggregated from the logs — no additional event format.
metrics.empty: No values in this period yet.

perTemplate.title: Cost per template
perTemplate.help: “per case” = model cost per case of this template — the number for management (in brackets: cases with calls).

gates.title: Approvals (early warning)
gates.help: A falling approval share = the proposals no longer fit — check per gate.

budget.title: Model budget
budget.help: 0 = no budget. From 80 % the log warns; at 100 % with “stop” only local models are called — tasks stay workable.
budget.stopped: Budget exhausted — paid model calls are refused until the month turns.

security.title: Security
security.help: Every model call runs through the instance's guardrails (ADR-0038): suspected injections are flagged, secrets, links and personal data removed, oversized inputs and calls beyond the cap refused.

briefings.title: AI steps as judged at the gates
briefings.help: Every decision at a gate judges the AI steps before it. Per version of the briefing: if the share drops after a change, the earlier version was better.

knowledge.title: Knowledge spaces
knowledge.intro: What the agents may know: policies, price lists, instructions — each space with a data class and a responsible person. Indexing and search stay on this instance.
knowledge.empty: No spaces yet. An app may declare some; your own are created here.
knowledge.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens — templates bind by this identifier.
knowledge.dataClassHelp: The class of the most sensitive content. A step using this space may only call models cleared for that class.
knowledge.uploadHelp: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, web page, text, scan, photo or recording — read locally (OCR, transcription); a new version replaces the passages, the old original stays.
knowledge.noDocuments: No documents in this space yet.
knowledge.tryHelp: What an agent step sees of this space: the best-matching passages with their source.
knowledge.question: Question or keywords
knowledge.sourcesHelp: Websites this space keeps itself up to date from: the instance reads the pages within the chosen scope, takes the chosen document types (including linked PDF and office files on the same site) and checks for changes at the interval. robots.txt is respected; other websites are never entered.
knowledge.noSources: No web source yet. Enter a website and the space fills up on the next run.
knowledge.scopeHelp: Linked files on the same website are taken in every scope.
knowledge.docTypesHelp: What goes into the space. Web pages are read for their links even without “Web pages”.
knowledge.maxDepthHelp: How many clicks away from the start page.
knowledge.excludeHelp: One pattern per line, e.g. */archive/* or ?print=

solutions.title: Solutions
solutions.intro: Every installed solution as a tree: processes (BPMN), decisions (DMN), AI tasks, skills, tools and types – per package, what is in sight there. “Prove” runs the sidecar tests under the chosen configuration and colours the path into the diagram.
solutions.none: No format-2 solution is installed. Format-1 bundles migrate with “migrate-solution”.
solutions.missingRecordings: {n} recording(s) missing – record them from the workshop with “--record”.
solutions.saved: Saved – the solution was validated and reloaded.

panel.neverRan: This step has never run in this instance.
panel.pickStep: Click a step in the diagram to see its settings and last run.
panel.englishIsDefault: English is the prompt language; other languages are optional.
panel.outputFormat: One field per line: name = description
panel.hashChanges: changes on save – recordings will no longer match
panel.clientLong: Actuator on the device (browser or person) – waits as a “Deliver” task

new.name: Name
new.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; becomes the file and folder name.
new.title: Title
new.aiHelp: Id of the briefing behind the AI step. A missing one is created alongside. Existing: {existing}
new.processHelp: A runnable process is created: start → AI step → human approval → end. Then build on from there on the canvas.
new.decisionHelp: Decision taken at the gate – leave empty if the case should stop there.
new.noSamples: This solution has no sample files under samples/ yet – put one there first.
new.caseIdHelp: Short name of the case, e.g. small-invoice-is-archived.
new.recordHelp: Calls the bound model once for real and stores its answer as a recording; afterwards the case runs without a model.
new.createdCase: Test case {id} added to the sidecar.
new.aiKindHelp: A briefing with role, instructions and output fields – no free prompt. Adjust it in the form afterwards.
new.decisionKindHelp: A decision table (FIRST) with one input and two rules as a starting point.
new.templateHelp: An existing process as the starting point – copied with its AI steps, decisions and tools; the original stays unchanged.

card.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and _; the step id inside the process.
card.label: Label
card.outcomeHelp: Name of the outcome (done, approved, elapsed …). Empty only into a gateway.
card.outcomeParallel: Connections out of a parallel gateway stay unnamed.
card.inline: The briefing sits in the process file (inline) – edit it in the source.

hint.start: The process trigger. Exactly one per process.
hint.ai: A model works from a briefing; outcomes done/failed.
hint.gate: A person decides; outcomes e.g. approved/rejected.
hint.action: A tool or an internal action (archive, export, forward …).
hint.decision: A DMN table picks the outcome.
hint.call: Calls another process and waits for it.
hint.timer: Waits for a duration; outcome elapsed.
hint.xor: Names a step's outcomes: unnamed in, named out.
hint.parallel: Fork and join (in pairs): unnamed out, branches meet in the second parallel gateway.
hint.end: End of the process – or chain into a next process.

start.title: Start {id}
start.help: One field per contract input. Numbers and JSON lists are sent as such.
start.extraHelp: For inputs the contract does not name.
start.started: Case {id}… started – see To decide and Cases.

solutions.exportHint: Validates the solution and downloads it as .tgz – to submit or share.
solutions.importHint: A .bpmn file as a process of this solution, a bundle (.tgz) as a whole solution – say from a local installation – or a workflow from n8n, Activepieces, Make or Zapier (.json, Zapier also as .zip) as a draft with a translation report.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.blocked: Release only once no findings are open
drafts.releaseHint: Takes the draft into the solution – new cases start with it from then on
drafts.explain: A draft runs nowhere: it becomes part of the solution only once released. Until then: check, look, discard.

report.title: Translation report
report.roles: Bind model role {roles} to a model

designer.gateHint: A person decides before it goes on – required before anything with outside effect.

actionHint.mail: Through the instance's mailbox; needs an approval before it.
actionHint.record: Write one row into a collection (e.g. tasks, contacts).
actionHint.rows: Read the rows of a collection – as a list for the next steps.
actionHint.knowledge: File a text as a document into a knowledge space.
actionHint.links: Pull web addresses out of a text or document.
actionHint.figures: Own figures: cases, approvals, errors, cost.
actionHint.archive: Put the case and its files into the archive.
actionHint.export: Export the case as a file.

designer.xorHint: Take one of several ways depending on a condition.
designer.parallelHint: Several ways at once – and join them again.
designer.noData: No data before this step yet
designer.startFormHint: These fields are filled by whoever starts the case (or by the trigger). Empty default = required.
designer.approvingHint: E.g. approved – every outcome named is a person's "yes".
designer.ruleHint: Data that make two decisions "the same" – aitmation suggests rules from them.
designer.testRunHint: The saved process runs right away with these inputs. Approvals stop it as in operation – nothing goes out unchecked.
designer.noStartForm: This process has no start form.
designer.saveFirst: Save or discard first – otherwise the changes to the process are lost.

tasks.filePlaceholder: Pick an image, video or audio file
tasks.pasteHint: or paste the image into the card with Ctrl+V

ops.title: Operations
ops.intro: What ran, what is running, what it waits on, what comes next — and what the models cost.
ops.noErrors: No errors in the last 24 hours.

catalog.intro: Reviewed solutions from the platform: install or update – every solution is checked before its first start (signature, validator, trust level).
catalog.revokedHint: The platform has revoked these solutions. Switch them off under Apps → Installed; running cases remain.
catalog.notTrusted: This trust level is not enabled in the administration (trusted_levels).
catalog.confirmText: The bundle is downloaded, checked against the platform's signature, validated and then loaded as a solution. It contains no code, only declarations.
catalog.confirmRoles: Needs model roles: {roles} – bind them under Administration → Models.
catalog.unverified: Level declared but not signed by the platform

results.stub: Steps {steps} ran without a model (stub) – that is why the content is missing.
results.stubLink: Set up a model under Administration → Models

board.title: Tasks
board.intro: Tasks, bugs, ideas and questions of every member as a board. Created by hand, from the chat or from cases and meeting minutes; every card is a versioned row of the "Tasks" collection.
board.whatExample: e.g. follow up on the Müller offer
board.chatHint: Works in the chat too: "Create task: follow up on the Müller offer".

record.title: Record a meeting
record.intro: Without a bot: this browser records the meeting running in another tab (Teams, Meet, Zoom on the web) or in the room and hands the recording to the minutes – summary, decisions, action items for approval.
record.tabAudio: Audio of the meeting tab (you pick the tab when starting)
record.hint: Tell the participants that you are recording. The recording stays in the browser until you stop; then it goes to the chosen member.
record.done: Recording handed over – the minutes will wait for your approval shortly.
record.unsupported: This browser cannot record (no MediaRecorder). Use Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
record.noProcess: The “Meeting minutes” solution is not installed for this member.
record.noTabAudio: No audio was shared for the chosen tab – tick “Share tab audio”.
record.tooLarge: Recording larger than 24 MB – record shorter or in two parts.
